raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Allow to select best implementation of linear gemm from Flashinfer. This new approach uses auto backend in autotuner that sweeps over all available backends since https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/6392 was recently merged in new FI v0.7.2.post1 and integrated to vLLM https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63466.

Currently, I use default value of PDL flag in FI (PDL=false). This still does not allow to sweep over some gemm kernels implementations in FI that use PDL=true. In parallel to this PR I will open a PR to FI that enables sweep over both PDL=false and PDL=true in case default value is set.
After PR in FI is merged and a new FI release is bumped in vllm, I will set --linear-backend to `flashinfer` by default to enable us using the most performant gemm kernel in runtime.

---

</details>

detail.body:
## Overview

Allow to select best implementation of linear gemm from Flashinfer. This new approach uses auto backend in autotuner that sweeps over all available backends since https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/6392 was recently merged in new FI v0.7.2.post1 and integrated to vLLM https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63466.

Currently, I use default value of PDL flag in FI (PDL=false). This still does not allow to sweep over some gemm kernels implementations in FI that use PDL=true. In parallel to this PR I will open a PR to FI that enables sweep over both PDL=false and PDL=true in case default value is set.
After PR in FI is merged and a new FI release is bumped in vllm, I will set --linear-backend to `flashinfer` by default to enable us using the most performant gemm kernel in runtime.

+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("kernel_cls", "backend"),
+    [
+        (FlashInferCutlassNvFp4LinearKernel, "cutlass"),
+        (FlashInferCuteDslNvFp4LinearKernel, "cute-dsl"),
+        (FlashInferAutoNvFp4LinearKernel, "auto"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_qutlass_nvfp4_uses_the_kernel_flashinfer_backend(kernel_cls, backend):
+    """The Qutlass NVFP4 transform runs mm_fp4 with the backend of the layer's
+    kernel; --linear-backend=flashinfer's kernel must map to "auto" instead of
+    failing model loading."""
+    kernel = kernel_cls.__new__(kernel_cls)
+    assert QutlassNvFP4LinearMethod._get_flashinfer_gemm_backend(kernel) == backend

 # SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+import functools
+
 import pytest
 import torch
 import torch.nn.functional as F
@@ -49,3 +51,37 @@ def test_flashinfer_bf16_cutedsl_correctness(
     expected = F.linear(x, weight, bias)
 
     torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, rtol=2e-2, atol=2e-1)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "m,n,k",
+    [
+        (1, 1024, 1024),
+        (64, 2048, 3072),
+        (512, 1024, 1000),
+        # N not a multiple of 8 (MoE shared_expert_gate, in_proj_ba at TP8) must
+        # fall back to F.linear instead of aborting FlashInfer's autotuning.
+        (64, 1, 2048),
+        (64, 12, 2048),
+    ],
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("tune", [False, True])
+def test_flashinfer_bf16_auto_correctness(m: int, n: int, k: int, tune: bool) -> None:
+    """--linear-backend=flashinfer dispatches to mm_bf16(backend="auto") without
+    pdl, with and without autotuning across FlashInfer's BF16 backends."""
+    from flashinfer import autotune
+
+    gemm = layer_utils.dispatch_unquantized_gemm("flashinfer")
+    # A plain function here means the F.linear fallback.
+    assert isinstance(gemm, functools.partial)
+    assert gemm.keywords == {"vllm_backend": "flashinfer", "pdl": None}
+
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    x = torch.randn(m, k, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.1
+    weight = torch.randn(n, k, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.1
+
+    with autotune(tune):
+        actual = gemm(None, x, weight)
+    expected = F.linear(x, weight)
+
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, rtol=2e-2, atol=2e-1)

@@ -186,6 +186,8 @@ def apply_weights(
 class FlashInferCutlassNvFp4LinearKernel(NvFp4LinearKernel):
     """NVFP4 GEMM via FlashInfer's CUTLASS wrapper."""
 
+    _flashinfer_backend = "cutlass"
+

@@ -255,7 +257,7 @@ def apply_weights(

-            backend="cutlass",

+class FlashInferAutoNvFp4LinearKernel(FlashInferCutlassNvFp4LinearKernel):
+    """NVFP4 GEMM via FlashInfer mm_fp4(backend="auto") on the CUTLASS weight
+    layout. FlashInfer's auto candidates (CUTLASS and cuDNN on SM10x) share
+    that layout; TRT-LLM, which needs shuffled weights, is never one of them."""
+
+    _flashinfer_backend = "auto"
+
+
 class FlashInferTrtllmNvFp4LinearKernel(NvFp4LinearKernel):
     """NVFP4 GEMM via FlashInfer's TensorRT-LLM wrapper."""

@@ -82,8 +82,10 @@ def _get_flashinfer_gemm_backend(kernel: NvFp4LinearKernel) -> str:
         """
         kernel_type = type(kernel)
         for key, kernels in _LINEAR_BACKEND_KERNEL_MAP.items():
-            if not key.startswith("flashinfer_") or kernel_type not in kernels:
+            if not key.startswith("flashinfer") or kernel_type not in kernels:
                 continue
+            if key == "flashinfer":
+                return "auto"
             backend = key.removeprefix("flashinfer_")
             # flashinfer GEMM backend uses "cute-dsl", not "cutedsl"
             return backend.replace("cutedsl", "cute-dsl")

@@ -15,6 +15,7 @@
 from vllm.platforms import CpuArchEnum, current_platform
 from vllm.utils.flashinfer import (

 )

@@ -99,9 +100,11 @@ class _FlashInferBf16Backend:

+    # False leaves mm_bf16's pdl argument at its FlashInfer default.
+    pass_pdl: bool = True
 
 
-def _can_use_flashinfer_cutedsl_bf16(

     x: torch.Tensor,

     bias: torch.Tensor | None,
@@ -125,15 +128,7 @@ def _can_use_flashinfer_cutedsl_bf16(
 
     k = x.shape[-1]
     n = weight.shape[0]
-    if (
-        k <= 0
-        or n <= 0
-        or x.numel() == 0
-        or weight.shape[1] != k
-        or k % 128 != 0
-        or x.data_ptr() % 32 != 0
-        or weight.data_ptr() % 32 != 0
-    ):
+    if k <= 0 or n <= 0 or x.numel() == 0 or weight.shape[1] != k:
         return False
     return bias is None or (
         bias.is_cuda
@@ -145,7 +140,41 @@ def _can_use_flashinfer_cutedsl_bf16(
     )
 
 
+def _can_use_flashinfer_cutedsl_bf16(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    bias: torch.Tensor | None,
+) -> bool:
+    return (
+        _can_use_flashinfer_bf16(x, weight, bias)
+        and x.shape[-1] % 128 == 0
+        and x.data_ptr() % 32 == 0
+        and weight.data_ptr() % 32 == 0
+    )
+
+
+def _can_use_flashinfer_auto_bf16(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    bias: torch.Tensor | None,
+) -> bool:
+    # Until flashinfer-ai/flashinfer#8226, auto keeps CUTLASS as a candidate when
+    # N or K is not a multiple of 8 (e.g. N=1 shared_expert_gate), and
+    # autotuning then aborts in its can_implement().
+    return (
+        _can_use_flashinfer_bf16(x, weight, bias)
+        and x.shape[-1] % 8 == 0
+        and weight.shape[0] % 8 == 0
+    )
+
+
 _FLASHINFER_BF16_BACKENDS = {
+    "flashinfer": _FlashInferBf16Backend(
+        flashinfer_backend="auto",
+        is_supported=is_flashinfer_auto_bf16_gemm_supported,
+        can_implement=_can_use_flashinfer_auto_bf16,
+        pass_pdl=False,
+    ),
     "flashinfer_cutedsl": _FlashInferBf16Backend(
         flashinfer_backend="cute-dsl",
         is_supported=is_flashinfer_cutedsl_bf16_gemm_supported,
@@ -169,7 +198,7 @@ def cuda_flashinfer_bf16_gemm_impl(
     x: torch.Tensor,
     weight: torch.Tensor,
     bias: torch.Tensor | None,
-    pdl: bool,
+    pdl: bool | None,

 ) -> torch.Tensor:
     backend_spec = _get_flashinfer_bf16_backend(vllm_backend)
@@ -193,7 +222,7 @@ def cuda_flashinfer_bf16_gemm_fake(
     x: torch.Tensor,
     weight: torch.Tensor,
     bias: torch.Tensor | None,
-    pdl: bool,
+    pdl: bool | None,
     vllm_backend: str,
 ) -> torch.Tensor:
     return x.new_empty((*x.shape[:-1], weight.shape[0]))
@@ -206,7 +235,7 @@ def cuda_flashinfer_bf16_gemm(
     bias: torch.Tensor | None = None,
     *,
     vllm_backend: str,
-    pdl: bool,
+    pdl: bool | None,
 ) -> torch.Tensor:
     return torch.ops.vllm.cuda_flashinfer_bf16_gemm(
         x,
@@ -883,5 +912,5 @@ def dispatch_unquantized_gemm(
     return functools.partial(
         cuda_flashinfer_bf16_gemm,
         vllm_backend=linear_backend,
-        pdl=current_platform.is_arch_support_pdl(),
+        pdl=(current_platform.is_arch_support_pdl() if backend_spec.pass_pdl else None),
     )

@@ -40,18 +40,20 @@ def flashinfer_bf16_mm(
     a: torch.Tensor,
     b: torch.Tensor,
     bias: torch.Tensor | None,
-    pdl: bool,
+    pdl: bool | None,
     backend: str,
 ) -> torch.Tensor:
     from flashinfer import mm_bf16
 
+    # pdl=None keeps FlashInfer's default.
+    kwargs = {} if pdl is None else {"pdl": pdl}
     return mm_bf16(
         a,
         b,
         bias=bias,
-        pdl=pdl,
         out_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
         backend=backend,
+        **kwargs,
     )
 
 
@@ -223,6 +225,30 @@ def is_flashinfer_cutedsl_bf16_gemm_supported() -> bool:
         return False
 
 
+@functools.cache
+def is_flashinfer_auto_bf16_gemm_supported() -> bool:
+    """Return whether FlashInfer mm_bf16(backend="auto") is available.
+
+    mm_bf16.is_backend_supported() only knows concrete backends, so require one
+    of them to support the device. "auto" runs FlashInfer's SM100 dispatcher.
+    """
+    if not (
+        current_platform.is_cuda()
+        and current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100)
+        and has_flashinfer_bf16_gemm()
+    ):
+        return False
+    capability = current_platform.get_device_capability()
+    if capability is None:
+        return False
+    from flashinfer import mm_bf16
+
+    try:
+        return bool(mm_bf16.is_compute_capability_supported(capability.to_int()))
+    except (AttributeError, RuntimeError, TypeError, ValueError):
+        return False
+
+
 def _missing(*_: Any, **__: Any) -> NoReturn:
     """Placeholder for unavailable FlashInfer backend."""
     raise RuntimeError(
@@ -1166,7 +1192,7 @@ def flashinfer_scaled_fp4_mm(
     if alpha is None:
         alpha = torch.ones(1, dtype=torch.float32, device=a.device)
 
-    if backend in ("cutlass", "cudnn"):
+    if backend in ("cutlass", "cudnn", "auto"):
         block_scale_a = block_scale_a.view(torch.uint8)
         block_scale_b = block_scale_b.view(torch.uint8)
